acceptance: `evolve scan secrets --staged` on a fixture with a staged AWS-key-shaped string exits 1 and masks the value (red: unknown command)
A clean diff exits 0; `--diff main...HEAD` scans that range
fix: Add `evolve scan secrets [--diff <ref>|--staged]` (default: the staged diff). It runs ScanDiff and prints each finding with file, line and rule, masking the matched value. Exit 0 when clean, 1 on any finding, 2 on git I/O. Document it in runtime-reference.md and name it in the /commit skill's steps.
source: console, 2026-09-30, core-function CLI inventory (operator request: a CLI request for each core function)
summary: secretleakscan.ScanDiff finds secret-shaped strings in a unified diff (internal/phases/secretleakscan/secretleakscan.go:46); only its test calls it. The secret-leak-scan phase runs only inside a cycle, so a console change reaches `evolve ship --class manual` with no deterministic secret check; the operator relies on the reviewer agents.
title: There is no secret scan of a diff outside a cycle, and secretleakscan.ScanDiff exists with no caller; add `evolve scan secrets`
